# What will a Trump Account be worth, and how much of it is actually yours?

> Free calculator for the federal Trump Account child savings account (One Big Beautiful Bill Act, 26 U.S.C. 530A): projects the $1,000 federal seed deposit plus family and employer contributions to age 18 or later, and applies the IRA-style pro-rata withdrawal rule -- the mechanic every 529-plan comparison misses.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
